def solve(n):
    k = int(input())

    p = list(map(float, input().split()))

    dp = [[0.0] * (1 << n) for _ in range(2)]
    isgood = [False] * n
    good = []

    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] != 0:
            isgood[i] = True
            good.append(i)

    dp[0][0] = 1.0
    c = 1

    sum_mask = [0.0] * (1 << n)
    sum_mask[0] = 1.0
    for j in range(1, 1 << n):
        x = (j & -j).bit_length() - 1  # equivalent to __builtin_ctz
        sum_mask[j] = sum_mask[j ^ (1 << x)] - p[x]

    for i in range(min(len(good), k)):
        for j in range(1 << n):
            dp[c][j] = 0.0

        for j in range(1 << n):
            if bin(j).count('1') != i:
                continue
            for next_idx in good:
                if not ((j >> next_idx) & 1):
                    dp[c][j ^ (1 << next_idx)] += dp[c ^ 1][j] * p[next_idx] / sum_mask[j]
        c ^= 1

    c ^= 1
    for i in range(n):
        if not isgood[i]:
            print("0.000000000000")
        else:
            ans = 0.0
            for j in range(1 << n):
                if (j >> i) & 1:
                    ans += dp[c][j]
            print(f"{ans:.12f}")

while True:
    try:
        n = int(input())
        solve(n)
    except EOFError:
        break
